Title: Generally Available: Azure Storage Actions is now in 22 more regions

Body.Content:
Azure Storage Actions is now available in several more Azure regions, enabling expanded global access and greater data residency options. This includes regions where the service was previously in preview. Additional regions where the service is now generally available include:

·       Australia East

·       Australia Southeast

·       Brazil south

·       Brazil Southeast

·       Canada Central

·       Central India

·       Central US

·       France Central

·       Germany North

·       Germany West Central

·       North Central US

·       North Europe

·       Norway West

·       South Africa West

·       South Central US

·       Sweden South

·       Switzerland North

·       Switzerland West

·       UAE Central

·       West Europe

·       West US

·       West US 2

Learn more:

  • See the Azure blog.
  • Refer to the quickstart guide.  
  • For further details and the full list of supported regions, please refer to the documentation.
